history_same_time_snapshots.comparison: Descriptive matched COUPLED-minus-OFF response under C14; pressure=P+PB at mass points, geopotential=PH+PHB at native interfaces, W at native vertical faces; no interpolation or causal attribution. Differing OFF/COUPLED wrfinput hashes are expected for these analysis arms, and each arm is bound to its corresponding frozen candidate inputs. Cloud/ice/snow/graupel inventories use the existing hybrid dry mass calculated separately from each arm’s history at each snapshot time and are reported over all native cells and interior cells. These diagnostics do not establish observational skill, a pure-model causal effect, or full-field treatment attribution.
